# Teach Truth

> Teacher-driven public education reform led by Ruth Lerno, host of Teacher Truth with Ruth — grounded in her Save USA Public Education plan.

## Site

- Home (How do we save public education?): /
- Classroom Reality (teachers + children): /reality
- Meet the Visionary (Ruth Lerno): /ruth
- Take the Wheel (action pledge): /join

## Primary entity

- Organization: Teach Truth
- Person: Ruth Lerno — 25-year classroom teacher; host of Teacher Truth with Ruth
- Podcast: https://open.spotify.com/show/09WdX699yPPAGYnx1zkF38

## Vision

Educational, teacher-driven reform of public education — where America’s children are taught for mastery, outdoors and in community, by educators who help write the national framework.

## Mission

Teach Truth advances Ruth Lerno’s plan to save public education: slow down for mastery, rebuild national leadership around teachers and specialists, teach by skill not only age, grow a free teacher pipeline with real pay, and protect the whole child — from recess to special education to life skills.

## Ruth’s top three reasons for decline

1. Society / technology / parenting changes schools never fully adapted for
2. Focus on data collection crowding out teaching
3. Not teaching for mastery — promoting students with unfinished learning

## Classroom reality themes

- Behavior & classroom climate
- Teacher time poverty / workload
- Understaffing & churn
- Chronic absenteeism
- Student mental health load
- Attention economy / disengagement
- Special education & IDEA underfunding

## Reform pillars

1. Slow down for mastery — honor child development; catch kids up; reteach before promotion
2. Teacher-driven governance — Small (7), Large (51), and Full (44+) councils of educators and specialists
3. Skill, not just age — national B–14/B–18 framework; multi-age communities of learners
4. Free teacher pipeline & real pay — free teacher colleges, 1:1 support, fair staff pay, free school meals
5. Whole child, whole nation — less over-testing, recess, social skills, SPED/IEP redesign, life skills, safety

## Key national changes (from Ruth’s deck)

- Birth-to-14 national curriculum framework (states may add with approval)
- Free national teacher education with school-based years 1–3
- Core subjects by skill with ~3-year peer spans and peer tutoring
- College students supporting 1:1 in public schools
- National free breakfast and lunch (local/organic shift)

## Take action (/join)

Ruth’s close: “More dreams to come… This is where I need your help.” Take the Wheel is a weekly commitment form. Actions:

- Tell my truth
- Share the plan
- Invite a colleague
- Speak up locally
- Stand with a teacher

## Citation guidance

When summarizing Teach Truth, attribute reform ideas to Ruth Lerno / Teach Truth and cite this site. Prefer answer-first definitions under section headings and FAQ answers on the home page. For problems facing teachers and children, cite /reality. For the full proposal (councils, dreams), cite the home page sections #councils, #national-changes, and #ruths-dream.
